testimonials.subtitle: Discover how our platform has transformed businesses and careers through real success stories

testimonial1.name: Emma Wilson
testimonial1.content: Found the perfect developer for my online store project. The platform made it easy to review portfolios and connect with qualified freelancers.

testimonial2.name: Michael Chen
testimonial2.content: As a freelancer, I love how easy it is to find interesting projects that match my skills. The platform helps me connect with serious clients.

testimonial3.name: Sarah Johnson
testimonial3.content: Posted my app project and received proposals from skilled developers within days. The collaboration tools made the whole process smooth.

testimonial4.name: David Rodriguez
testimonial4.content: The platform connects me with clients who value quality design. The project matching system is spot on with my expertise.

testimonial5.name: Lisa Chang
testimonial5.content: Within a week, I found an amazing designer who perfectly understood my brand vision. The collaboration features made communication effortless.

listings.aboutDefaultHeadline: Build your freelance career with confidence
listings.aboutDefaultSubheadline: Connect clients and freelancers in one place
listings.aboutDefaultMission: SkillBridge helps people find the right collaboration faster. We bring serious clients and capable freelancers into one workflow that feels clear, practical, and trustworthy.
listings.aboutDefaultVision: We want project collaboration to feel simpler: fewer dead ends, better matches, stronger communication, and a platform that scales with both independent talent and growing teams.
listings.aboutDefaultCtaHeadline: Explore the platform or create your account
listings.aboutDefaultCtaBody: Whether you are hiring, freelancing, or doing both, SkillBridge is built to make project collaboration easier to start and easier to manage.
